verdict.rationale: Unleash's own docs describe strategy variants that expose different versions of a feature to users for A/B and multivariate testing, so multivariate flags are a first-party capability. Nothing in the pack shows variants carrying typed dynamic configuration values such as strings, numbers or JSON. missing for 10: documented variant payloads with string/number/JSON types, SDK retrieval of typed config values, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can serve multivariate flags and dynamic configuration values (strings, numbers, JSON), not just booleans

citations.quote: Variants let you expose different versions of a feature to users, for example, as part of A/B and multivariate testing.
